scenarios.name: USER_TAKEOVER
scenarios.response: Automation paused: human user physical takeover detected. Physical ownership released; focus preserved without stealing back.
scenarios.invariant_verified: Physical user input immediately preempted automation; interaction ownership released.

scenarios.name: USER_CLOSED_RESOURCE
scenarios.response: Task paused: user explicitly closed the application. Human close respected as intentional; automatic reopening aborted.
scenarios.invariant_verified: Target process closed by human user; respected as explicit intent without auto-reopen.

scenarios.name: PROCESS_CRASHED
scenarios.response: Process crash detected (Injected fault: PROCESS_CRASHED). Transitioned to RECOVERING state for bounded environmental recovery of calculator.
scenarios.invariant_verified: Unexpected process termination safely handled; transitioned to RECOVERING state.

scenarios.name: USER_MODIFIED_RESOURCE
scenarios.invariant_verified: Target file hash changed externally; invalidates cache and requests clarification.

scenarios.name: RESOURCE_DISAPPEARED
scenarios.invariant_verified: Dependent resource disappeared; plan halted before step N+1 without blind write.

scenarios.name: FOCUS_CHANGED
scenarios.response: Focus changed by user. Physical automation paused without stealing focus back.
scenarios.invariant_verified: Active workstation focus switched; Astra pauses immediately without focus stealing.

scenarios.name: MODAL_APPEARED
scenarios.invariant_verified: Unexpected modal dialog detected; execution paused to avoid hazardous keystrokes.

scenarios.name: RESOURCE_REPLACED
scenarios.invariant_verified: Resource identity changed; plan paused awaiting human clarification.

scenarios.name: UNKNOWN_WORLD_DRIFT
scenarios.invariant_verified: Ambient workstation environment drifted; marked WORLD_STATE_CHANGED.

scenarios.name: FILESYSTEM_CHANGED
scenarios.invariant_verified: Underlying filesystem modified externally; stale assumptions paused safely.
